get_company_information.title: Get company information
get_company_information.description: Read the connected company's profile: name, organisation number, company type, contact phone and email, address and whether it has a Bokio Business Account. A cheap way to confirm the company id and token work.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

output.description: The company: id, name, organizationNumber, companyType, phone, email, hasBBA and address.

list_accounts.title: List the chart of accounts
list_accounts.description: List every bookkeeping account in the company's chart of accounts (BAS plan plus custom accounts) with number, name and type. Use it to pick account numbers for journal entries, payments and items; get_account adds the current balance for one account.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

query.description: Filter expression `field operator value`, e.g. `name~Acme`. Operators: == != > < >= <= ~ (contains), combined with && and ||. Filterable fields: account (number), name, accountType.

output.description: All matching accounts, each with account (number), name and accountType (basePlanAccount or customAccount).

get_account.title: Get an account and its balance
get_account.description: Read one account from the chart of accounts by its number (e.g. 1930 for the business bank account), including its current balance.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

output.description: The account: account, name, accountType and accountBalance.

list_fiscal_years.title: List fiscal years
list_fiscal_years.description: List the company's fiscal years with start and end dates, accounting method (cash or accrual) and whether each is open or closed. Needed for the fiscal year id that export_sie_file takes.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

query.description: Filter expression `field operator value`, e.g. `name~Acme`. Operators: == != > < >= <= ~ (contains), combined with && and ||. Filterable fields: startDate, endDate, accountingMethod (cash|accrual), status (open|closed).

output.description: A page of fiscal years: `items`, plus totalItems, totalPages and currentPage.

get_fiscal_year.title: Get a fiscal year
get_fiscal_year.description: Read one fiscal year by id: its start and end dates, accounting method and open or closed status.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

output.description: Under `fiscalYear`: id, startDate, endDate, accountingMethod and status.

export_sie_file.title: Export a fiscal year as SIE
export_sie_file.description: Download the SIE file (the Swedish standard accounting export with accounts, balances and every verification) for one fiscal year, e.g. to hand the books to an accountant or another system. Get the fiscal year id from list_fiscal_years.
export_sie_file.notes: The file is served as application/octet-stream in the SIE text format (traditionally PC8/CP437 encoded), so non-ASCII characters may not decode cleanly.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

fiscal_year_id.description: Id (UUID) of the fiscal year to export.

list_journal_entries.title: List journal entries
list_journal_entries.description: List the company's journal entries (verifications), each with number, title, date, debit/credit lines and reversal links. Filter with `query`, e.g. `date>=2025-01-01`.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

query.description: Filter expression `field operator value`, e.g. `name~Acme`. Operators: == != > < >= <= ~ (contains), combined with && and ||. Filterable fields: title, journalEntryNumber, date, reversingJournalEntryId, reversedByJournalEntryId.

tag_id.description: Only entries carrying this tag (at entry or line level). Preview; needs the Tags feature on the price plan.

output.description: A page of journal entries: `items`, plus totalItems, totalPages and currentPage.

get_journal_entry.title: Get a journal entry
get_journal_entry.description: Read one journal entry by id: number, title, date, its debit and credit lines with account numbers and tags, and which entry it reverses or is reversed by.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

output.description: The journal entry: id, journalEntryNumber, title, date, items (id, account, debit, credit, tags), tags, reversingJournalEntryId and reversedByJournalEntryId.

create_journal_entry.title: Create a journal entry
create_journal_entry.description: Book a manual journal entry (verification) with balanced debit and credit lines against chart-of-accounts numbers. Debits must equal credits. For customer invoices and payments prefer the invoice tools, which book themselves; attach a receipt afterwards with the Bokio app, since file uploads are not supported here.
create_journal_entry.notes: A 400 carries an apiError whose innerCode explains validation failures.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

title.description: Entry title shown in the ledger, e.g. 'Office supplies'.

items.description: The lines, at least two and balanced: each {account: number, debit: number, credit: number, tags?: [{tagId, weight}]} with one of debit or credit set to 0.

tags.description: Entry-level tags [{tagId, weight}]. Use either these or line-level tags, not both.

output.description: The created journal entry with its id and journalEntryNumber.

reverse_journal_entry.title: Reverse a journal entry
reverse_journal_entry.description: Create the reversing entry for a journal entry, cancelling it in the books. Only entries created through the API can be reversed, not ones from the Bokio UI or belonging to an invoice, and an entry can only be reversed once.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

journal_entry_id.description: Id (UUID) of the journal entry to reverse.

set_journal_entry_tags.title: Replace a journal entry's tags
set_journal_entry_tags.description: Replace all tags (cost centres, projects and other dimensions) on a journal entry, either at entry level or per line, not both. Send an empty `tags` list and no line tags to clear them. Preview endpoint; needs the Tags feature.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

tags.description: Entry-level tags [{tagId, weight}]; must be empty when line_tags carries tags.

line_tags.description: Line-level tags: [{id: line id from get_journal_entry, tags: [{tagId, weight}]}].

output.description: The journal entry's tags after the update.

list_journal_entry_comments.title: List comments on a journal entry
list_journal_entry_comments.description: List the plain-text comments on a journal entry, oldest first, with author and timestamps.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

output.description: The comments: id, content, authorName, createdDatetime, updatedDatetime.

get_journal_entry_comment.title: Get a journal entry comment
get_journal_entry_comment.description: Read one comment on a journal entry by id: content, author name and timestamps.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

add_journal_entry_comment.title: Comment on a journal entry
add_journal_entry_comment.description: Add a plain-text comment to a journal entry created through the API, e.g. a reference to the source system. The author is shown as the integration's name. No markdown or HTML.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

content.description: The comment text, plain text only.

update_journal_entry_comment.title: Edit a journal entry comment
update_journal_entry_comment.description: Replace the text of a comment on a journal entry. Only comments created by this same integration can be edited.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

content.description: The new comment text, plain text only.

delete_journal_entry_comment.title: Delete a journal entry comment
delete_journal_entry_comment.description: Delete a comment from a journal entry. Only comments created by this same integration can be deleted.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

list_uploads.title: List uploads
list_uploads.description: List uploaded receipts and documents (images and PDFs) with description, content type and the journal entry each is attached to. Use the id with attach_upload_to_supplier_invoice. Uploading new files is not supported by this pack (the API needs multipart).

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

query.description: Filter expression `field operator value`, e.g. `name~Acme`. Operators: == != > < >= <= ~ (contains), combined with && and ||. Filterable fields: description, journalEntryId.

output.description: A page of uploads: `items`, plus totalItems, totalPages and currentPage.

get_upload.title: Get an upload
get_upload.description: Read one upload's details by id: description, content type and linked journal entry id.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

output.description: The upload: id, description, contentType and journalEntryId.

list_tag_groups.title: List tag groups and tags
list_tag_groups.description: List tag groups (dimensions such as Cost centre, Project, Department) with every tag in each. Tag ids from here go on journal entries and invoice lines. Preview; needs the Tags feature on the price plan.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

query.description: Filter expression `field operator value`, e.g. `name~Acme`. Operators: == != > < >= <= ~ (contains), combined with && and ||. Filterable fields: name, dimensionNumber.

output.description: A page of tag groups, each with id, name, alias, dimensionNumber and tags: `items`, plus totalItems, totalPages and currentPage.

items.description: The tag groups, each with id, name, alias, dimensionNumber and tags.

get_tag_group.title: Get a tag group
get_tag_group.description: Read one tag group by id with all of its tags. Preview; needs the Tags feature.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

output.description: The tag group: id, name, alias, dimensionNumber and tags.

create_tag_group.title: Create a tag group
create_tag_group.description: Create a tag group (a dimension used to classify bookkeeping, e.g. 'Cost centre'). Add its values with create_tag. For projects prefer create_project, which manages dimension 6 for you. Preview; needs the Tags feature.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

alias.description: Short alias for quick tagging, max 3 characters, unique per company.

dimension_number.description: SIE dimension number: 1 cost centre, 2 cost carrier, 6 project, 7 employee, 8 customer, 9 supplier, 10 invoice, 20+ free.

update_tag_group.title: Rename a tag group
update_tag_group.description: Change a tag group's name and alias. The dimension number cannot be changed. Preview; needs the Tags feature.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

name.description: New name of the tag group.

alias.description: Alias, max 3 characters, unique per company.

delete_tag_group.title: Delete a tag group
delete_tag_group.description: Delete a tag group and all its tags. Fails if any of its tags is used on a journal entry. Preview; needs the Tags feature.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

create_tag.title: Add a tag to a tag group
create_tag.description: Create a tag (value) in a tag group, e.g. 'Stockholm' under 'Cost centre'. Names are unique within the group. Preview; needs the Tags feature.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

output.description: The created tag: id and name.

update_tag.title: Rename a tag
update_tag.description: Rename a tag within its tag group. Preview; needs the Tags feature.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

delete_tag.title: Delete a tag
delete_tag.description: Delete a tag from its tag group. Fails if the tag is used on any journal entry. Preview; needs the Tags feature.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

list_projects.title: List projects
list_projects.description: List projects (dimension 6 tags enriched with name, number, dates, customer and active/archived status). Preview; needs the Tags feature.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

query.description: Filter expression `field operator value`, e.g. `name~Acme`. Operators: == != > < >= <= ~ (contains), combined with && and ||. Filterable fields: name, projectNumber, status (active|archived).

output.description: A page of projects: `items`, plus totalItems, totalPages and currentPage.

get_project.title: Get a project
get_project.description: Read one project by id: name, project number, status, dates, customer and backing tag.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

create_project.title: Create a project
create_project.description: Create a project; Bokio creates its dimension 6 (Project) tag, and the Project tag group if missing. Assign invoice and supplier-invoice lines to it via project_id. Preview; needs the Tags feature.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

project_number.description: Project number, unique per company (becomes the dimension 6 tag value).

customer_id.description: Id of the customer the project belongs to.

update_project.title: Update a project
update_project.description: Replace a project's name, number, dates and customer. Fields left out are cleared, so read it first with get_project. Preview; needs the Tags feature.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

project_number.description: Project number, unique per company (becomes the dimension 6 tag value).

customer_id.description: Id of the customer the project belongs to.

list_customers.title: List customers
list_customers.description: List the company's customers with contacts, address, payment terms and language, newest customer numbers first. Filter e.g. `name~Acme` to find a customer id for create_invoice.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

query.description: Filter expression `field operator value`, e.g. `name~Acme`. Operators: == != > < >= <= ~ (contains), combined with && and ||. Filterable fields: name, customerNumber, type, vatNumber, orgNumber.

output.description: A page of customers: `items`, plus totalItems, totalPages and currentPage.

get_customer.title: Get a customer
get_customer.description: Read one customer by id: name, number, type, VAT and organisation numbers, payment terms, contacts, address and language.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

create_customer.title: Create a customer
create_customer.description: Create a customer (company or private person) with contacts, billing address, payment terms and invoice language, ready to invoice with create_invoice.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

customer_number.description: Customer number, up to 24 characters. Omit to have the next number suggested (on update, to keep the current one).

org_number.description: Organisation number (or personal number for private customers).

payment_terms.description: Payment terms: days as digits (e.g. '30', shown as '30 days') or free text.

contacts.description: Contact people: [{name, email, phone, isDefault}]. On update include each existing contact's id.

id.description: Existing contact id; omit for a new contact.

address.description: Billing address {line1, line2?, city, postalCode, country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. SE), countrySubdivision? (required for GB, e.g. ENG)}.

output.description: The created customer with its id and customerNumber.

update_customer.title: Update a customer
update_customer.description: Replace a customer's details. Omitted fields are cleared (except customer_number, which is kept), so read it with get_customer first and send the full record.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

customer_number.description: Customer number, up to 24 characters. Omit to have the next number suggested (on update, to keep the current one).

org_number.description: Organisation number (or personal number for private customers).

payment_terms.description: Payment terms: days as digits (e.g. '30', shown as '30 days') or free text.

contacts.description: Contact people: [{name, email, phone, isDefault}]. On update include each existing contact's id.

id.description: Existing contact id; omit for a new contact.

address.description: Billing address {line1, line2?, city, postalCode, country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. SE), countrySubdivision? (required for GB, e.g. ENG)}.

delete_customer.title: Delete a customer
delete_customer.description: Delete a customer. Currently only customers that were created through the API can be deleted.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

list_items.title: List items (products and services)
list_items.description: List the saved items (goods, services and description-only lines) with unit, price, VAT rate and bookkeeping account, for reuse on invoice lines via item_id.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

query.description: Filter expression `field operator value`, e.g. `name~Acme`. Operators: == != > < >= <= ~ (contains), combined with && and ||. Filterable fields: description, itemType, productType, unitType, unitPrice, taxRate.

output.description: A page of items: `items`, plus totalItems, totalPages and currentPage.

get_item.title: Get an item
get_item.description: Read one saved item by id: description, type, unit, unit price, VAT rate and bookkeeping account.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

create_item.title: Create an item
create_item.description: Save a reusable product, service or text-only line for invoices. salesItem needs product_type, unit_type, unit_price and tax_rate.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

item_type.description: salesItem for a priced product or service; descriptionOnlyItem for a text-only line.

custom_unit_type.description: Unit text when unit_type is custom, up to 25 characters.

unit_price.description: Price per unit excluding VAT (required for salesItem).

tax_rate.description: VAT rate in percent, e.g. 25, 12, 6 or 0 (required for salesItem).

bookkeeping_account_number.description: Sales account to book to; omit to let Bokio choose from product type, VAT and customer.

output.description: The created item with its id.

update_item.title: Update an item
update_item.description: Replace a saved item's details; send every field you want to keep. Existing invoices are not changed.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

item_type.description: salesItem for a priced product or service; descriptionOnlyItem for a text-only line.

custom_unit_type.description: Unit text when unit_type is custom, up to 25 characters.

unit_price.description: Price per unit excluding VAT (required for salesItem).

tax_rate.description: VAT rate in percent, e.g. 25, 12, 6 or 0 (required for salesItem).

bookkeeping_account_number.description: Sales account to book to; omit to let Bokio choose from product type, VAT and customer.

delete_item.title: Delete an item
delete_item.description: Delete a saved item. Invoices that already used it keep their lines.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

list_invoices.title: List invoices
list_invoices.description: List customer invoices with customer, dates, amounts, status (draft, published, paid, overdue, credited...) and lines. Filter e.g. `status==overdue` or `invoiceDate>=2025-01-01`.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

query.description: Filter expression `field operator value`, e.g. `name~Acme`. Operators: == != > < >= <= ~ (contains), combined with && and ||. Filterable fields: type, customerRef.id, orderNumberReference, projectReference, buyerReference, contractReference, currency, totalAmount, status (draft, published, paid, overPaid, underPaid, overdue, credited, credit), invoiceDate, dueDate, metadata.<key>.

project_id.description: Only invoices with at least one line on this project.

output.description: A page of invoices: `items`, plus totalItems, totalPages and currentPage.

get_invoice.title: Get an invoice
get_invoice.description: Read one invoice by id: number, OCR reference, customer, dates, currency, totals, paid amount, status, line items, attachments, journal entry and credit notes.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

create_invoice.title: Create a draft invoice
create_invoice.description: Create a draft customer invoice with its lines. It gets a number only when published: follow with publish_invoice (and record_invoice to book it). Nothing is emailed to the customer by the API.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

customer_id.description: Id of the customer to invoice (list_customers / create_customer).

line_items.description: The lines. A sales line: {itemType: salesItem, description, productType: goods|services, quantity, unitPrice, taxRate, unitType?, bookkeepingAccountNumber?, discount?, itemRef?: {id}}. A text line: {itemType: descriptionOnlyItem, description}.

itemRef.description: {id} of a saved item to use as a template.

id.description: Existing line id; omit for new lines.

due_date.description: Due date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to derive it from the customer's or company's payment terms (else 30 days).

type.description: invoice or cashInvoice (a new invoice can only be invoice).

contact_id.description: Id of the customer contact to address the invoice to (default contact if omitted).

currency_rate.description: Exchange rate to SEK for a foreign currency (default 1).

delivery_address.description: Delivery address {line1, line2?, city, postalCode, country}.

tax_reduction.description: ROT/RUT tax reduction: {type: rot|rut, description, propertyType?, realEstateNumber?, tenantOrgNumber?, apartmentNumber?, deductionPeople: [{personalNumber, ...}]}.

metadata.description: Up to 10 string key/value pairs for your own use, filterable as metadata.<key>.

output.description: The created draft invoice with its id and totals.

update_invoice.title: Update a draft invoice
update_invoice.description: Replace every field of a draft invoice, lines included (keep existing lines by sending their id). Read it with get_invoice first. Only drafts can be updated.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

customer_id.description: Id of the customer to invoice (list_customers / create_customer).

line_items.description: The lines. A sales line: {itemType: salesItem, description, productType: goods|services, quantity, unitPrice, taxRate, unitType?, bookkeepingAccountNumber?, discount?, itemRef?: {id}}. A text line: {itemType: descriptionOnlyItem, description}.

itemRef.description: {id} of a saved item to use as a template.

id.description: Existing line id; omit for new lines.

due_date.description: Due date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to derive it from the customer's or company's payment terms (else 30 days).

type.description: invoice or cashInvoice (a new invoice can only be invoice).

contact_id.description: Id of the customer contact to address the invoice to (default contact if omitted).

currency_rate.description: Exchange rate to SEK for a foreign currency (default 1).

delivery_address.description: Delivery address {line1, line2?, city, postalCode, country}.

tax_reduction.description: ROT/RUT tax reduction: {type: rot|rut, description, propertyType?, realEstateNumber?, tenantOrgNumber?, apartmentNumber?, deductionPeople: [{personalNumber, ...}]}.

metadata.description: Up to 10 string key/value pairs for your own use, filterable as metadata.<key>.

delete_invoice.title: Delete a draft invoice
delete_invoice.description: Delete a draft invoice. Published invoices cannot be deleted; credit them with create_credit_note instead.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

add_invoice_line_item.title: Add a line to a draft invoice
add_invoice_line_item.description: Append one line to a draft invoice without resending the whole invoice. A sales line needs product_type, quantity, unit_price and tax_rate unless item_id supplies them.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

item_type.description: salesItem for a priced line, descriptionOnlyItem for a text line.

item_id.description: Saved item to use as a template; its values override the other fields except item_type and quantity.

custom_unit_type.description: Unit text when unit_type is custom.

bookkeeping_account_number.description: Override the automatically chosen sales account.

project_id.description: Project id to assign the line to.

publish_invoice.title: Publish an invoice
publish_invoice.description: Publish a draft invoice: it gets its invoice number and OCR reference and becomes final. The API does not email it; share it from Bokio. Irreversible except by crediting.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

record_invoice.title: Book an invoice
record_invoice.description: Record (book) a published invoice in the ledger, creating its journal entry for the receivable and sales.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

output.description: The invoice with its journal entry reference.

create_credit_note.title: Credit an invoice
create_credit_note.description: Create a draft credit note for the whole invoice. For a partial credit, adjust its lines with update_credit_note, then publish_credit_note.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

invoice_id.description: Id (UUID) of the invoice to credit.

output.description: The draft credit note with its id.

list_invoice_attachments.title: List invoice attachments
list_invoice_attachments.description: List the files attached to an invoice (shown as extra pages on it). Adding attachments is not supported by this pack (multipart upload).

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

query.description: Filter expression `field operator value`, e.g. `name~Acme`. Operators: == != > < >= <= ~ (contains), combined with && and ||. Filterable fields: fileName.

output.description: A page of attachments: `items`, plus totalItems, totalPages and currentPage.

get_invoice_attachment.title: Get an invoice attachment
get_invoice_attachment.description: Read one invoice attachment's details (id, file name, content type).

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

delete_invoice_attachment.title: Remove an invoice attachment
delete_invoice_attachment.description: Remove an attachment from a draft invoice.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

list_invoice_payments.title: List an invoice's payments
list_invoice_payments.description: List the payments registered against an invoice, each with date, amount in SEK, account and journal entry.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

query.description: Filter expression `field operator value`, e.g. `name~Acme`. Operators: == != > < >= <= ~ (contains), combined with && and ||. Filterable fields: date, sumBaseCurrency.

output.description: A page of payments: `items`, plus totalItems, totalPages and currentPage.

get_invoice_payment.title: Get an invoice payment
get_invoice_payment.description: Read one payment registered against an invoice.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

create_invoice_payment.title: Register an invoice payment
create_invoice_payment.description: Register money received for an invoice (full or partial), in SEK, into a payment account (default 1930). Then book it with record_invoice_payment. Use create_invoice_settlement for fees or currency differences.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

bookkeeping_account_number.description: Account the money went into; must be a payment account in the chart of accounts.

output.description: The created payment with its id.

record_invoice_payment.title: Book an invoice payment
record_invoice_payment.description: Record (book) a registered invoice payment in the ledger, creating its journal entry.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

output.description: The payment with its journal entry reference.

delete_invoice_payment.title: Delete an invoice payment
delete_invoice_payment.description: Delete a payment registered against an invoice, e.g. one entered by mistake.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

list_invoice_settlements.title: List an invoice's settlements
list_invoice_settlements.description: List settlements on an invoice: currency differences, bank fees, payment service fees, bad debt and balance adjustments.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

query.description: Filter expression `field operator value`, e.g. `name~Acme`. Operators: == != > < >= <= ~ (contains), combined with && and ||. Filterable fields: date, sumBaseCurrency.

output.description: A page of settlements: `items`, plus totalItems, totalPages and currentPage.

get_invoice_settlement.title: Get an invoice settlement
get_invoice_settlement.description: Read one settlement on an invoice: type, date, amount, VAT scheme and journal entry.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

create_invoice_settlement.title: Settle an invoice difference
create_invoice_settlement.description: Settle part of an invoice's outstanding amount that was not paid as money: a currency difference, a bank fee, or a payment service fee (e.g. Stripe). A positive amount reduces what is outstanding. Book it with record_invoice_settlement.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

type.description: currency (exchange-rate gain/loss), bankFee, or paymentServiceFee (Swedish companies only).

amount.description: Amount in SEK; negative increases the outstanding amount (e.g. a currency gain).

vat_scheme.description: Required for paymentServiceFee: how VAT on the fee is booked.

output.description: The created settlement with its id.

record_invoice_settlement.title: Book an invoice settlement
record_invoice_settlement.description: Record (book) an invoice settlement in the ledger, creating its journal entry.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

output.description: The settlement with its journal entry reference.

delete_invoice_settlement.title: Delete an invoice settlement
delete_invoice_settlement.description: Delete a settlement from an invoice, restoring the outstanding amount it had reduced.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

list_credit_notes.title: List credit notes
list_credit_notes.description: List credit notes with the invoice each credits, customer, dates, totals and draft/published status. Create one from an invoice with create_credit_note.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

query.description: Filter expression `field operator value`, e.g. `name~Acme`. Operators: == != > < >= <= ~ (contains), combined with && and ||. Filterable fields: type, customerRef.id, orderNumberReference, projectReference, buyerReference, contractReference, currency, totalAmount, status, creditDate, dueDate, metadata.<key>.

output.description: A page of credit notes: `items`, plus totalItems, totalPages and currentPage.

get_credit_note.title: Get a credit note
get_credit_note.description: Read one credit note by id with its lines, totals, original invoice and status.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

update_credit_note.title: Update a draft credit note
update_credit_note.description: Replace a draft credit note's dates, references and lines, e.g. to credit only 3 of 4 units. Read it with get_credit_note first and keep line ids. Line discounts come from the original invoice.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

credit_note_id.description: Id (UUID) of the draft credit note.

line_items.description: The credited lines, same shape as invoice lines; keep each existing line's id.

itemRef.description: {id} of a saved item to use as a template.

id.description: Existing line id; omit for new lines.

delivery_address.description: Delivery address {line1, line2?, city, postalCode, country}.

publish_credit_note.title: Publish a credit note
publish_credit_note.description: Publish a draft credit note, making it final and immutable.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

credit_note_id.description: Id (UUID) of the draft credit note.

record_credit_note.title: Book a credit note
record_credit_note.description: Record (book) a published credit note in the ledger, creating its journal entry.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

output.description: The credit note with its journal entry reference.

delete_credit_note.title: Delete a draft credit note
delete_credit_note.description: Delete a draft credit note. Published credit notes cannot be deleted.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

credit_note_id.description: Id (UUID) of the draft credit note.

list_suppliers.title: List suppliers
list_suppliers.description: List the company's suppliers with organisation and VAT numbers, currency, address and payment details (bankgiro, plusgiro, bank transfer or IBAN).

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

query.description: Filter expression `field operator value`, e.g. `name~Acme`. Operators: == != > < >= <= ~ (contains), combined with && and ||. Filterable fields: name, vatNumber, orgNumber.

output.description: A page of suppliers: `items`, plus totalItems, totalPages and currentPage.

get_supplier.title: Get a supplier
get_supplier.description: Read one supplier by id with address, currency and payment details.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

create_supplier.title: Create a supplier
create_supplier.description: Create a supplier with address and payment details, so supplier invoices can be registered against it.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for the supplier's invoices (default SEK); with a Bokio Business Account only BBA currencies are allowed.

address.description: Address {line1, line2?, city, postalCode, country (default SE)}.

payment_details.description: How to pay them, one of {type: bankgiro, bankgiroNumber}, {type: plusgiro, plusgiroNumber}, {type: transfer, clearingNumber, accountNumber}, {type: internationalPayment, iban, bic}.

output.description: The created supplier with its id.

update_supplier.title: Update a supplier
update_supplier.description: Replace a supplier's details; omitted fields are cleared, so read it with get_supplier first.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for the supplier's invoices (default SEK); with a Bokio Business Account only BBA currencies are allowed.

address.description: Address {line1, line2?, city, postalCode, country (default SE)}.

payment_details.description: How to pay them, one of {type: bankgiro, bankgiroNumber}, {type: plusgiro, plusgiroNumber}, {type: transfer, clearingNumber, accountNumber}, {type: internationalPayment, iban, bic}.

delete_supplier.title: Delete a supplier
delete_supplier.description: Delete a supplier. Currently only suppliers created through the API can be deleted.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

list_supplier_invoices.title: List supplier invoices
list_supplier_invoices.description: List bills from suppliers with supplier, number, dates, total, remaining amount, currency and attached uploads. Filter e.g. `dueDate<2025-07-01`.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

query.description: Filter expression `field operator value`, e.g. `name~Acme`. Operators: == != > < >= <= ~ (contains), combined with && and ||. Filterable fields: supplierRef.id, invoiceNumber, totalAmount, currency, invoiceDate, dueDate.

project_id.description: Only supplier invoices with at least one line on this project.

output.description: A page of supplier invoices: `items`, plus totalItems, totalPages and currentPage.

get_supplier_invoice.title: Get a supplier invoice
get_supplier_invoice.description: Read one supplier invoice by id: supplier, number, dates, total, remaining amount, currency, lines, uploads and journal entry.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

create_supplier_invoice.title: Register a supplier invoice
create_supplier_invoice.description: Register a bill received from a supplier, optionally linked to an already uploaded scan of it (upload_id from list_uploads).

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

total_amount.description: Invoice total including VAT, in the supplier's currency.

line_items.description: Lines [{description, quantity?, unitPrice, unitType?, taxRate?, projectRef?: {id}, costCenterRef?: {tagId}}] (preview). On update, lines not included are removed.

upload_id.description: Id of an existing upload holding the invoice document.

output.description: The created supplier invoice with its id.

update_supplier_invoice.title: Update a supplier invoice
update_supplier_invoice.description: Replace a supplier invoice's supplier, number, dates, total and lines. Read it with get_supplier_invoice first and keep line ids.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

total_amount.description: Invoice total including VAT, in the supplier's currency.

line_items.description: Lines [{description, quantity?, unitPrice, unitType?, taxRate?, projectRef?: {id}, costCenterRef?: {tagId}}] (preview). On update, lines not included are removed.

delete_supplier_invoice.title: Delete a supplier invoice
delete_supplier_invoice.description: Delete a supplier invoice registered by mistake. Its attached uploads remain in list_uploads.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

add_supplier_invoice_line_item.title: Add a line to a supplier invoice
add_supplier_invoice_line_item.description: Append one line to a supplier invoice. The supplier invoice must already have an upload attached (attach_upload_to_supplier_invoice).

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

project_id.description: Project to assign the line to.

attach_upload_to_supplier_invoice.title: Attach an upload to a supplier invoice
attach_upload_to_supplier_invoice.description: Link an existing upload (a scanned bill or receipt, from list_uploads) to a supplier invoice.

company_id.description: Bokio company id (UUID), as shown in the Bokio app's URL for the company.

upload_id.description: Id (UUID) of the upload to attach.
